wants.topic: Feature-length 'Full Movie' style compilations of major epics (Ramayana, Neem Karoli Baba)
wants.evidence: Anant Gatha's 'RAMAYAN: THE EPIC JOURNEY OF RAM' achieved 73.52x vsNormal, and Rasiya Films' 'Ramayana Full Movie' achieved 29.71x vsNormal.

wants.topic: Lesser-known folk legends featuring core deities (e.g., Adhaiya Brahmin, Ganga Sagar & Sati)
wants.evidence: Rasiya Films' Adhaiya Brahmin stories with Maa Durga and Shri Ram generated 15.21x and 10.48x vsNormal; Mystery of the World's Sati & Ganga Sagar katha hit 26.75x vsNormal.

wants.topic: Modern Saint & Deity Avtar Linkages (Neem Karoli Baba as Hanuman Avtar)
wants.evidence: Anant Gatha's Neem Karoli Baba parts achieved 46.94x and 21.71x vsNormal with over 14M combined views.

wants.topic: Unusual mythological encounters & origins (Satyavati & Parashar Rishi, Ganesh Gajanan origin)
wants.evidence: Mystery of the World's Satyavati katha reached 17.45x vsNormal; KATHA SAGAR's Ganesh origin reached 33.8M views (6.39x vsNormal).

wants.topic: Timely Festival Vrat Kathas (Dhanteras and Diwali Lakshmi Pujan)
wants.evidence: Gyan Adhyatmik Katha dominated during festival periods with Dhanteras and Diwali Kathas reaching up to 12.05x vsNormal.

gaps: High-production 4K single-video cinematic compilations combining full sagas into continuous feature lengths.
Detailed narratives of obscure Hindu folk stories (e.g., Adhaiya Brahmin, Ganga Sagar backstory) that combine high narrative drama with mainstream deities.
In-depth biographical kathas connecting contemporary 20th-century saints (e.g., Neem Karoli Baba) directly to ancient Vedic avatars.
saturated: Generic short moral stories with vague titles (e.g., 'Moral Story', 'Bhondu story', 'Durga bhakt moral story').
Devotional music tracks/bhajans published on story-focused katha channels.
English-titled videos targeted at domestic Hindi-speaking audience (e.g., 'When Hanuman Ate the Sun').
Standard non-mythological historical documentaries (e.g., Chanakya & Chandragupta).
Repetitive day-by-day Navratri routine kathas published without unique narrative hooks.
